spec_match.rationale: Walks the inherited window-drag cascade through a live mini-DOM — explicit, inherited, and effective values per node — matching the property's inherited nature and the classic button-keeps-inheriting-drag bug.

interactive.rationale: Eleven per-node selects re-derive the cascade; changing one flipped the generated CSS (.titlebar drag → no-drag) in the driven run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised cascade walker exactly.

edge_cases.rationale: The inherit-into-interactive-child bug case is the page's centrepiece.

references.rationale: Has an external spec link but omits the chromestatus.com/feature/5201338641285120 self-heal link.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 3 pass / 3 fail on this build without window-drag.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: changed a node's select; cascade table and generated CSS updated; zero console errors.

accessibility.rationale: Selects are operable but only one carries an explicit label and cascade changes are unannounced.

openQuestions.title: Label every per-node select
openQuestions.detail: Eleven selects drive the cascade but most lack accessible names tying them to their node row; aria-label per node would fix it.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: changed a cascade select and watched the effective-value walk plus generated CSS update (.titlebar window-drag: no-drag); zero console errors; panel honestly 3 pass / 3 fail.
